sloka: चकार सुरसा वक्त्रं चत्वारिंशत्तथोच्छ्रितम् ।बभूव हनुमान्वीरः पञ्चाशद्योजनोच्छ्रितः ॥५-१-१६४॥
transliteration: cakāra surasā vaktraṁ catvāriṁśattathocchritam ।babhūva hanumānvīraḥ pañcāśadyojanocchritaḥ ॥5-1-164॥

translations.english: Provoked, Hanuman further stretched his body to thirty yojanas and Surasa on her own enlarged her mouth to forty yojanas. Then the great hero Hanuman stretched his body to fifty yojanas.
